items.title: 19.1 Mass defect aur binding energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of mass defect, binding energy and binding energy per nucleon (PDF 138-140, printed 134-136).

blocks.text: Mukhtalif nuclei ke mass napne ke tajurbe batate hain ke nucleus ka mass hamesha us ke tamam protons aur neutrons ke kul mass se kam hota hai. Is kam (ghaib) mass ko mass defect Δm kehte hain:

Yahan mₚ proton ka mass, mₙ neutron ka mass aur m_nucleus poore nucleus ka mass hai (Z protons aur A − Z neutrons). Yeh ghaib mass energy mein badal kar nucleus banane mein kharch hua. Yeh energy Einstein ke mass-energy relation se nikalti hai:
Yeh energy nucleus ki potential energy hai jise Binding Energy (B.E) kehte hain. Is ki tareef (definition):

blocks.title: Binding Energy
blocks.text: Nucleus ko us ke ajza (constituents), yani neutrons aur protons, mein todne ke liye nucleus par jitna kaam (work) karna parta hai, use binding energy kehte hain.

Binding energy ko negative maana jata hai, bilkul gravitational potential ki tarah jo infinity (bohat door) par zero li jati hai: bandhe hue nucleus ki energy alag alag nucleons ki energy se kam hoti hai. Mazbooti (stability) ka behtar paimana binding energy per nucleon hai, yani nucleus ko alag alag nucleons (neutrons aur protons) mein todne ke liye har nucleon par aust (average) kitni energy chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke absolute gravitational potential 'zameen ki satah par' zero liya jata hai; sahi yeh hai ke woh infinity par zero liya jata hai (isi liye bandhi hui energies negative hoti hain). Kitab 'building energy per nucleon' bhi likhti hai; murad binding energy per nucleon hai.
Sub-atomic particles ke mass aam taur par atomic mass unit (amu ya u) mein likhe jate hain. 1 u carbon-12 (¹²₆C) ke ek azad atom ke mass ka barahwan (1/12) hissa hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 1 u ko '²₆C' ke atom ke mass ka '1/112th' likhti hai. Sahi: 1 u carbon-12 (¹²₆C) atom ke mass ka 1/12 hai.

blocks.alt: Protons (+) aur neutrons ka nucleus, 'Nucleus (smaller mass)', jama 'Binding energy' ka dabba, teer ke baad wahi protons aur neutrons alag alag bikhre hue, 'Separated nucleons (greater mass)'.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: nucleus ko us ke protons aur neutrons mein todne ke liye tawanai deni parti hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nucleus ko torne ke liye binding energy bahar se deni parti hai. Is liye alag alag nucleons ki kul kamiyat (greater mass) nucleus ki kamiyat (smaller mass) se zyada hoti hai; yahi farq mass defect hai.

blocks.title: Example 19.1
blocks.problem: Helium nucleus ka mass defect aur binding energy nikalein. Diya gaya: mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, nucleus ka mass = 6.646786 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.
steps: Helium nucleus mein 2 protons aur 2 neutrons hain: Δm = 2mₚ + 2mₙ − m_nucleus
Einstein ki equation: B.E = Δmc² = 0.048318 × 10⁻²⁷ kg × (3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 4.34862 × 10⁻¹² J
blocks.answer: B.E = 27 MeV (4 nucleons mein taqreeban 6.8 MeV per nucleon)

blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: kuch atomic masses

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki table ¹H ka mass 1.007276 u deti hai; yeh proton ka mass hai. Hydrogen-1 atom ka mass 1.007825 u hai (table ke baqi masses bhi atoms ke hain), is liye yahan 1.007825 u likha gaya hai.

Nucleon number A ke muqable binding energy per nucleon ka graph banana mufeed hai. Graph par nucleus ki jagah batati hai ke nucleus kitna mustahkam hai aur kya us ke fission ya fusion se energy mil sakti hai. Fig. 19.1 dikhati hai ke shuru mein hydrogen nucleus (sirf ek proton) ki binding energy zero hai. Hydrogen se helium tak graph bohat neeche girta hai; yani hydrogen ko helium mein badalne se bohat energy nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: Nucleon number A (0 se 250) ke muqable binding energy fi nucleon (0 se -10 MeV, neeche ki taraf) ka graph. Curve H (0) se shuru ho kar Li aur Be se tezi se girta, Mg se guzar kar Fe ke qareeb taqreeban -8.8 MeV par sab se neeche pohanchta, phir Ag, I, Hg, Bi aur Ra se ahista uth kar 235U par taqreeban -7.6 MeV tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.1: nucleon number ke muqable ausat binding energy fi nucleon (kitab ki Figure 19.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab binding energy ko manfi maanti hai, is liye graph 0 se -10 MeV ki taraf neeche jata hai: curve jitna neeche, nucleus utna mazbooti se bandha. Iron (Fe) ke qareeb curve sab se neeche (taqreeban -8.7 MeV) hai. Kitab ne 'Bi' ka teer A = 80 ke qareeb aur 'I' ka teer A = 150 ke qareeb chhapa hai; bismuth (Bi) ka mass number 209 aur iodine (I) ka 127 hai, is liye hum ne dono teer sahi jagah lagaye hain. Kitab ke matan ka 'building energy per nucleon' binding energy fi nucleon hai.

Iron ⁵⁶₂₆Fe par curve taqreeban 8.7 MeV per nucleon ki inteha (maximum) tak pohanchta hai; iron sab se mustahkam nuclide hai. Sab se mustahkam nuclei A = 50 aur 80 ke darmiyan hain. Us ke baad curve ke aakhir tak binding energy per nucleon aahista aahista kam hoti jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab iron ka mass number 'z6' chhapti hai; sahi ⁵⁶₂₆Fe hai.

Yani bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei ki binding energy per nucleon kam hoti hai. Yeh bohat ahem baat hai. Agar bhari nucleus do aise nuclei mein toote jo curve ke sab se neeche wale hisse ke qareeb hon, to woh zyada mazbooti se bandhe (stable) honge. Is amal ko nuclear fission kehte hain; insaan pehle hi is se bohat zyada bijli bana raha hai.

Isi tarah curve ki halki taraf ke do nuclei agar mil kar ek nucleus ban jayen to woh zyada mazbooti se bandhe honge. Maslan deuterium aur tritium mil kar zyada stable helium nucleus banayen to bohat zyada energy nikalti hai. Lekin aisa amal shuru karna aasan nahi; is ke liye bohat zyada temperature chahiye, jaisa qudrati taur par Sooraj aur doosre sitaron mein hai jahan fusion se behad energy nikalti hai. Asal usool: jis nuclear reaction mein products ki binding energy per nucleon barh jaye, us se energy milti hai.

blocks.prompt: u wale masses istemal kar ke deuteron (²H nucleus) ki binding energy nikalein (1 u = 931.5 MeV).
blocks.explanation: Atomic masses se: Δm = m(¹H atom) + mₙ − m(²H atom) = 1.007825 + 1.008665 − 2.014102 = 0.002388 u (electrons dono taraf barabar hain). B.E = 0.002388 × 931.5 = 2.2 MeV, yani taqreeban 1.1 MeV per nucleon.

items: Mass defect Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus (19.1); B.E = (Δm)c² (19.2).
B.E per nucleon iron (⁵⁶Fe) ke qareeb sab se zyada (8.7 MeV); bhari nuclei ka fission aur halke nuclei ka fusion energy dete hain.
